notes: Fixes multi-copy 40x20 mm label printing: each sticker was coming out on its own large default page with huge blank gaps, because the browser @page hints never reach the Windows printer driver, which kept paginating at A4/its default stock. Labels now go through an exact-media silent pipeline: the label is rasterized at the printer DPI and printed as N pages on a DEVMODE locked to a custom 40x20 mm form — copy 2 feeds immediately after copy 1, no A4 pages, no gaps, no print dialog. The label modal preview shows all copies stacked consecutively (N x 20 mm) with a diagnostics banner (printer, media, pages, raster size), and Settings gains a label printer + DPI picker plus a 5-copy acceptance test button.
